title: Karol G, David Guetta, Kate Hudson & More Getting Stars on Hollywood Walk of Fame: Full 2026-27 List
summary: Recording stars being honored in other fields include Cheech & Chong (motion pictures) and Nicole Scherzinger (live theater/live performance).
contentText:
Karol G , David Guetta , Ramones , Grandmaster Flash and the late Waylon Jennings are among the music stars who are set to receive stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the coming year. They, along with 27 other names from the worlds of recordings, motion pictures, television, live theater/live performance and sports entertainment, were announced at a press conference that was livestreamed from Funko Hollywood in Hollywood on Thursday (July 23).

Singer/percussionist Sheila E. and actress/model Ming-Na Wen (who both have stars on the Walk of Fame) announced the new honorees in tandem with Ron Frierson, president/CEO of the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce.

The star for Jennings is this year’s only posthumous star. The country legend died in 2002.

The world of hip-hop is well-represented, with stars for Grandmaster Flash and Lil Wayne as well as DJ Chalamagne tha God , who is known as “Voice of the Culture.”

Kate Hudson , who received an Oscar nomination earlier this year for her performance in Song Sung Blue , will receive a star 10 years after her mother Goldie Hawn and stepfather Kurt Russell were jointly honored.

There will be one double ceremony, honoring Elle Fanning and Dakota Fanning , who the Walk of Fame says are the first sisters to be jointly honored.

Several recording stars are being honored in other fields of endeavor, including Cheech & Chong (for motion pictures) and Nicole Scherzinger (for live theater/live performance).

Scherzinger, who won a Tony Award in 2025 for Sunset Blvd ., Jo Koy and dancer Roberto Bolle are the only representatives in the Live Theatre/Live Performance category. Chalamagne tha God is the only representative in the Radio category. Fox sports analyst Jimmy Johnson is the only representative in the Sports Entertainment category.

The Walk of Fame Selection Committee, made up of past Walk of Famers, selected these new honorees from what was described as hundreds of nominations. The selections were ratified by the Hollywood Chamber’s board of directors on July 22.

“The Walk of Fame Selection Committee is proud to welcome the Class of 2027 to one of the most enduring symbols of achievement in entertainment,” Peter Roth, former CEO of Warner Bros. Television and chairman of the Walk of Fame selection committee, said in a statement. “These extraordinary individuals have each made a lasting impact on audiences around the world through their talent, creativity, and dedication to their craft. We are honored to recognize their remarkable contributions and look forward to celebrating them as they take their place in Hollywood history.”

Dates have not been scheduled for these star ceremonies. Recipients have two years to schedule star ceremonies from the date of selection before they expire. Upcoming star ceremonies are usually announced 10 days prior to the dedication on the Walk of Fame’s  official website .
